description.name: Qiqi Auto Accept
description.tagline: Auto-accept paid and free pending orders; optionally delete stale unpaid pending orders.
description.short: Accepts Pending orders immediately when the invoice is Paid, or when a free-trial order is placed (amount=0), and can delete Unpaid Pending orders older than a set number of hours.
description.long: Qiqi Auto Accept watches InvoicePaid, OrderPaid, and AfterShoppingCartCheckout and calls localAPI AcceptOrder for Paid+Pending and free Pending (amount=0, invoiceid=0) orders. AfterCronJob catches leftovers and optionally deletes stale Unpaid + Pending orders. Refunded, Cancelled, Collections, Fraud, and non-Pending orders are never modified.
features: Accept paid pending orders immediately on InvoicePaid / OrderPaid
Accept free-trial Pending orders on AfterShoppingCartCheckout + cron catch-up
AfterCronJob catch-up for leftover Paid + Pending orders
Optional delete of stale Unpaid + Pending orders (default 6 hours)
Never touches Refunded, Cancelled, Collections, Fraud, or non-Pending orders
Admin log with today counts and last error
